scope: Single stream, original full video played once per trial in real Chrome through production BrowserController, OpenRouter, InsightFace and rented SAM GPU; not physical camera/WHEP or long-duration soak.
primary_metric: Frames with closed complete or approximate contours for every subject known to SAM / all distinct presented frames, including source startup.
strict_metric: Production complete_contour_frames / distinct_presented_frames; excludes approximate completion.

recommendation.applies_to: Docker data volume, this sample and recorded settings only; two full-video trials per candidate are not a reliability guarantee.

limitations: Sequential trials with shared-host and upstream timing variation; storage comparison is not a randomized causal experiment.
VLM and face source-to-result latency is separate from video playback delay.
Information-to-next-SAM timing measures the next opportunity, not guaranteed geometric association or event visibility.
First positive and first visible same-label events may use different evidence; their difference is descriptive, not per-evidence end-to-end attribution.
Some positive VLM reports never produced a display label; contour coverage does not establish event/name accuracy.
No known-gallery face matches in this video. Identity-name boarding remains covered by offline tests, not a positive real recognition example.
Metadata may arrive after capture of an earlier video frame and before its buffered presentation; semantic validity is still clamped to the next SAM batch.
Persistent result journaling and bounded archival commit backlog can still apply backpressure to SAM; model independence does not eliminate resource queues.
